10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:20873278-a1da-4c.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you a seasoned enterprise sales professional passionate about shaping the next generation of artificial intelligence? Join 10x Team as a Freelance Enterprise Sales Director – AI Trainer and leverage your sales expertise to improve cutting-edge AI models, all while enjoying the flexibility of remote, project-based work. About Us: 10x Team connects independent professionals with leading AI labs to advance artificial intelligence. We are seeking experienced enterprise sales leaders based in the EU or UK to help train AI systems in areas such as strategic sales, client engagement, deal structuring, negotiation, pipeline management, and sales best practices. Key Responsibilities: - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to enterprise sales, account management, and business development - Assess the accuracy and practicality of AI-driven recommendations on sales strategies, customer engagements, and contract negotiations - Develop real-world case studies and scenarios from your experience in enterprise sales - Create scenario variations covering sales pipelines, CRM usage, forecasting, and client retention - Identify gaps or risks in AI recommendations and provide clear, actionable feedback - Influence how AI systems interpret sales approaches, compliance, and relationship management best practices About You: - Proven experience as an Enterprise Sales Director or in a similar senior sales role - Based in the EU or UK - Strong understanding of B2B sales, deal structuring, negotiation, and enterprise client management - Analytical, detail-oriented, and able to provide structured, constructive feedback - Available 8–20 hours per week and comfortable working remotely and asynchronously Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance assignments – 100% remote - Shape the future of AI-driven enterprise sales solutions - Access to ongoing professional development through the 10x Team AI Academy - Supportive community of independent experts, clear assignment briefs, and streamlined onboarding How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Step into the future of AI-powered enterprise sales – apply today! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

acquisition-acquisition:ashbyhq:ef2f2e2d.description: ROLE: We’re hiring a Production Manager to build and lead the production infrastructure behind ACQ Media and the personal brands of Alex Hormozi, Leila Hormozi, and Sharran Srivatsaa. This role is for someone who has managed full production pipelines at scale and can point to predictable, studio-level execution across multiple concurrent projects. ACQ Media is the in-house media engine producing long-form series, podcasts, and daily short-form content that reaches millions globally. Our media is engineered to drive measurable brand growth and business impact. We operate like a studio with structured workflows, repeatable systems, performance visibility, and AI-native production infrastructure. In this role, you will own the operational backbone of our media department across pre-production, filming, and post-production handoffs, often managing two to three production batches simultaneously. You will oversee casting workflows, run-of-show development, vendor coordination, crew logistics, budgeting, asset integrity, and cross-functional communication while ensuring execution remains predictable as output scales. This is a management role based in Las Vegas. We are looking for a proactive, systems-driven operator who does not need to be taught how sets run or how production timelines are structured. You actively leverage project management software and AI tools to increase visibility, coordination speed, and operational precision. RESPONSIBILITIES: - Own end-to-end production flow across multiple concurrent batches, ensuring predictable execution from casting and pre-production through filming and post handoff. - Build and manage detailed production timelines, run-of-show documents, call sheets, vendor coordination, crew logistics, travel, locations, and contingency plans. - Lead operational oversight on shoot days, maintaining schedule discipline, communication clarity, and studio-level standards under pressure. - Oversee budgeting, cost tracking, and vendor management while identifying efficiencies without sacrificing quality. - Enforce clean asset management, file structures, and version control to ensure zero lost footage and frictionless post-production workflows. - Implement and optimize project management software and AI-driven systems to increase visibility, coordination speed, and operational precision. REQUIREMENTS: - 5+ years of experience managing production flow in a professional studio, agency, broadcast, digital-first, or news-style production environment. - Demonstrated experience overseeing multiple concurrent production batches with complex, multi-step processes. - Strong experience with project management software such as Monday, Asana, or similar platforms, with the ability to build structured production systems. - Proven ownership of budgets, vendor coordination, crew logistics, and run-of-show documentation. - Systems-oriented, proactive operator who leads confidently in high-pressure environments and actively integrates AI tools to improve operational efficiency. RESULTS: - Production pipelines run smoothly across multiple concurrent batches without missed steps or preventable delays. - Shoot days operate on schedule and at consistent studio quality with clear run-of-show execution. - Zero lost footage with organized, searchable asset archives and clean post-production handoffs. - Teams operate with clarity and confidence, knowing what to do and when to do it. - Operational systems scale to support increased output without increased chaos. LOCATION: - Las Vegas, NV (3 days onsite per week) - Onsite attendance is required for all on-set filming days - Support for relocation to Las Vegas will be provided - Light travel may be required COMPENSATION: - $80,000 - $90,000 base salary - The salary range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. distro-distro:lever:4e18f8a3-3b84-4587-b.description: About Us Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). jobgether-jobgether:lever:950b9ef2-2c21-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, IT Operations based in Brazil. This is a senior IT leadership role responsible for the reliability, security, and operational performance of a complex technology environment. You will lead the teams, processes, and systems supporting change management, service delivery, infrastructure operations, and operational security. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in critical incidents, governance, audits, and executive reporting. You will establish disciplined operating practices, strengthen service quality, and drive continuous improvement across IT operations. Success will be measured through availability, SLA performance, incident reduction, audit readiness, and team development. This is an opportunity to build mature operational capabilities while partnering closely with technology, security, risk, compliance, and business leadership. Own and continuously improve the enterprise change management program, including policies, workflows, approval gates, implementation readiness, rollback planning, and post-change validation. Chair the Change Advisory Board (CAB), ensuring production changes are properly assessed, approved, documented, and supported by complete audit trails. Lead the IT service desk and end-user support organization, establishing service-level targets for response, resolution, customer satisfaction, and first-contact resolution. Oversee employee onboarding and offboarding, device provisioning, access management, and the lifecycle of laptops, peripherals, software, and other IT assets. Establish clear Tier 1 through Tier 3 support structures, escalation paths, ownership models, and knowledge-management practices. Own the full incident and problem management lifecycle, including detection, triage, escalation, resolution, executive communication, root cause analysis, and corrective actions. Coordinate cross-functional responses to critical Sev 1 and Sev 2 incidents and provide regular availability, outage, and operational trend reporting to senior leadership. Oversee 24x7 monitoring, alerting, observability, and operational readiness across production and corporate environments. Manage monitoring and incident-response technologies such as Splunk, Datadog, PagerDuty, Site24x7, Jira, and Confluence, ensuring strong detection coverage and effective on-call practices. Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to confirm new services meet operational, monitoring, and support requirements before production release. Maintain operational readiness for SOC, PCI, and other applicable compliance and audit frameworks, including access controls, change controls, evidence gathering, and control attestations. Manage technology vendors, managed service providers, procurement forecasts, software licensing, IT assets, and operational cost accountability. Build, lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary IT operations team while establishing performance standards, career paths, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement. Requirements 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including at least 5 years in IT operations leadership or management. Demonstrated experience owning a formal change management program, including CAB leadership, governance, documentation, and audit accountability. Strong track record managing 24x7 IT operations, critical incident response, problem management, and SLA-driven service delivery. Experience supporting SOC, PCI, or comparable security and compliance frameworks with measurable audit and compliance outcomes. Hands-on familiarity with modern monitoring, observability, ticketing, and collaboration platforms such as Splunk, Datadog, PagerDuty, Site24x7, Jira, and Confluence. Strong understanding of ITIL-aligned Incident, Change, and Problem Management practices. Proven ability to build operational processes and governance

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:a9f2c3c5-27e1-4f2b.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] SKELAR — це venture builder, який будує міжнародні продуктові IT-компанії за правилами світу венчурних інвестицій. Разом із нашими ко-фаундерами ми збираємо сильні команди, щоб запускати tech-бізнеси та перемагати на глобальних ринках. Сьогодні в SKELAR десяток бізнесів у різних нішах — від EdTech до маркетплейсів. Це компанії, що потрапляють у рейтинги ТОП-стартапів та продуктових компаній України, займають найвищі позиції в AppStore та розробляють платформи, якими користуються мільйони людей. А ще про бізнеси SKELAR пишуть TechCrunch, Wired та інші світові медіа. Наразі ми шукаємо активного та відповідального Junior HelpDesk Engineer. Ти будеш відповідати за весь цикл: від розпакування нового MacBook до налаштування корпоративної мережі та організації технічної частини онлайн-івентів. Ми будуємо AI-Native команду, тому ти матимеш доступ до сучасних AI-інструментів та можливість інтегрувати їх у щоденні процеси підтримки. Ми пропонуємо роботу з сучасним стеком (macOS, Okta, Google Workspace) та процесами за стандартами Enterprise. Що для нас важливо: - Досвід роботи в ІТ-підтримці (Internal Support) від 6 місяців або закінчена профільна ІТ-освіта; - Впевнене розуміння та досвід адміністрування macOS (пріоритет), а також Windows / Linux; - Практичне розуміння мережевих технологій (базове налаштування комутаторів, L1/L2, розуміння роботи Wi-Fi); - Досвід збирання, розбирання та діагностики апаратного забезпечення (Hardware); - Високий рівень емпатії, сервісності та комунікабельності; - Розуміння принципів роботи Service Desk та тікет-систем. - Англійська (A1/A2+): Рівень Survival — достатній для читання технічної документації або інтерфейсів програм, можливо, для базового листування. Буде перевагою: - Досвід щоденного використання AI-асистентів (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot тощо) для траблшутингу або написання скриптів; - Досвід роботи з Google Workspace, Okta, Slack; - Досвід налаштування обладнання для онлайн-трансляцій (OBS Studio, мікрофони, камери); Що буде в зоні твоєї відповідальності:: - Підготовка та налаштування робочих місць для нових співробітників у львівському офісі; - Ведення повного циклу інвентаризації (Asset Management) — від закупівлі до списання; - Опрацювання заявок від користувачів у тікет-системі з дотриманням SLA; - Базове обслуговування офісної мережевої інфраструктури (патчинг, комутація); - Організація та технічний супровід онлайн-трансляцій для внутрішніх комунікацій; - Контроль за дотриманням політик інформаційної безпеки (ISMS); - Оптимізація рутинних процесів Helpdesk за допомогою AI-інструментів. Tech Stack (Інструментарій): - Ticketing Systems: Розуміння життєвого циклу заявки (Open -> In Progress -> Resolved). Досвід роботи з Jira Service Desk, Zendesk або аналогами буде великим плюсом. - Asset Management: Вміння вести облік техніки (інвентаризацію) — уважність до деталей, робота з таблицями (Excel/Google Sheets) або спеціалізованим ПЗ для інвентаризації. - Комунікація: Досвід адміністрування корпоративних месенджерів, зокрема Slack. - Стрімінг: Знання обладнання для трансляцій (камери, мікрофони, пульти) та софту (наприклад, OBS Studio). У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. - Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інт

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:f86141.title: People Partner, GTM
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:f86141.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for an exceptional People Partner to support our growing Go-to-Market organization, including Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and GTM Operations, out of our NYC office. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role: you'll work closely with GTM leadership to build the people strategy, programs, and policies that let the org scale sustainably, not just maintain what already exists. You'll act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to managers and employees across the full HR lifecycle, including employee relations, performance management, org design, coaching, and program design, while partnering closely with specialist teams (Compensation, Benefits, People Ops, Legal, Talent Acquisition) so the GTM org has the support it needs. This role suits someone who sees ambiguity as an opportunity to build rather than an obstacle, and who's energized by working shoulder to shoulder with commercial leaders in a fast-moving environment. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Partner with GTM leadership to translate business priorities into people strategies: org design, workforce planning, and talent development. - Act as the primary HR point of contact for GTM employees and managers, providing guidance on performance management, employee relations, coaching, and policy interpretation, and conducting investigations when issues arise. - Lead and support core HR cycles for your client group: performance reviews, compensation planning, promotion cycles, and engagement surveys. - Analyze people data and GTM-specific metrics (attrition, ramp time, quota attainment correlation, etc.) to identify trends and recommend proactive interventions. - Partner with Talent Acquisition on headcount planning, role scoping, and hiring strategy for GTM roles. - Support org changes, promotions, and role transitions specific to sales/GTM compensation structures (e.g., commission plans, quota-carrying roles). - Drive change management and communication for company-wide People initiatives within the GTM org. - Coach and develop frontline and senior GTM managers on leadership and people management skills. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5+ years of HR experience, with at least 2+ years supporting a Sales, Marketing, or broader GTM/commercial client group (experience with sales compensation structures is a strong plus). - Proven experience as an HRBP or similar strategic HR role, ideally in a high-growth, fast-paced environment (SaaS/tech background preferred). - Strong understanding of employee relations, performance management, and organizational design principles. - Comfort with data: able to build and interpret people analytics/dashboards and use them to influence decisions. - Excellent judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential matters. - Strong communication and relationship-building skills; able to credibly influence senior commercial leaders. - Working knowledge of NY State and NYC employment law. - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek a skilled supervisor to drive results. This individual will need to be the gold standard in all our processes, so attention to detail and high drive to win is a must. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You will manage a team of highly trained, optimistic Advisors, Operators, and Attendants to provide exceptional guest service in a fun, interactive atmosphere. We need a dedicated team member that has experience in a supervisory role, and a willingness to learn the car wash industry. Location: Speeders Car Wash (Omaha 11) 15275 Weir Plaza, Omaha, NE 68106

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:c4563bd5-298.title: Arabic (Gulf) Quality Control Specialist - Project Lyra
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:c4563bd5-298.description: Overview Are you passionate about linguistics, language quality, and evaluation? We are launching an exciting language evaluation project and are looking for Arabic (Gulf)-speaking linguistics experts to join our team as Quality Control Specialists. In this role, you will assess and refine AI-generated language outputs, focusing on linguistic accuracy, grammar, and cultural relevance. Your expertise will play a critical role in improving conversational AI systems. What you will do: Review and evaluate AI-generated text for linguistic accuracy, grammatical correctness, and cultural appropriateness. Identify issues and provide high-quality rewritten responses to improve language outputs. Develop natural prompts and responses in the target language to enhance conversational datasets. Collaborate with global teams to improve the quality and performance of AI language models. Project Details: Start Date: ASAP Duration: 4 weeks Commitment: ~20 hours/week (flexible schedule) Job Type: Freelance contract Pay Rate: $38 USD/hour Location: Egypt, Saudi Arabia (Remote) Requirements: Strong academic or professional background in linguistics (required). Native or professional proficiency in Arabic (Gulf) with excellent written communication skills. Deep understanding of grammar, linguistic structures, and cultural nuances of the target language. Experience in language review, evaluation, or similar roles. Comfortable working with structured tasks such as preference ranking, prompt-response writing, grammaticality checks, and text improvement. Detail-oriented with the ability to deliver clear, constructive feedback. This is a unique opportunity to apply your linguistics expertise to cutting-edge AI projects. Join our team and help shape the future of AI communication!

zealnetwork-zeal-network:ashbyhq:fe67f7a.description: ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+, Traumautoverlosung and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities. Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for an AI Operational Excellence Specialist to own the AI agenda across Customer Operations. You will be the driving force behind identifying, implementing, and monitoring AI-powered features and projects that improve efficiency, quality, and customer experience across the Customer Operations Department. This is a hands-on, highly cross-functional role for someone who thrives on running multiple projects at once, loves working with diverse stakeholders, and gets genuine satisfaction from tidying up messy processes and finding smarter ways of working. The Operational Excellence team sits at the center of Customer Operations, partnering closely with our two frontline teams Customer Support and Payments, Fraud & Verification, to continuously improve how we work. Our mission is to make operations faster, smarter, and more scalable, with AI and automation as key levers.
